newsitem.title: USA: Crown Cork files $1.5 bln shelf statement.
newsitem.headline: Crown Cork files $1.5 bln shelf statement.

text.p: Crown Cork & Seal Co Inc said on Tuesday that it has filed a shelf registration statement to offer up to $1.5 billion of debt securities.

The company, which makes metal cans and closures for the beverage industry, said it plans to issue $1.2 billion of the securities to refinance its debt after the registration statement is made effective.

Proceeds from the proposed offering will be used to refinance a portion of the $1.9 billion of indebtedness arising from the company's February 1996 acquisition of CarnaudMetalbox SA, Crown Cork said.
Crown Cork said the remainder of the outstanding acquisition debt will continue to be financed through bank loans until it is repaid or refinanced.
Salomon Brothers, CS First Boston, Chase Securities and JP Morgan Securities will be managers in the upcoming offering, Crown Cork said.
